values.subject: HR benefits enrollment reminder: 7-Day Programmer Posture Camp
values.body_text: The benefits platform has added the 1,299-yuan Programmer Posture Camp, whose page uses promotional language such as “correct rounded shoulders in seven days,” “no training required,” and a countdown for remaining spots. This program is fee-based and provided by a third party; before participating, you must confirm personally and decide for yourself whether it is suitable.
